answer: Agents anchor their existence by performing 5,000,000 sequential hashing operations, a strict temporal constraint that mandates linear execution to prevent parallel shortcutting. An honest participant pays this cost once, while 1,000 fakes must incur 5,000,000,000 cycles to bypass the verifier. A node acts as a lagoon probe to monitor for execution jitter, while a shale analyzer audits the serialized output for validity. A final knoll filter inspects logs to reject any non-linear evidence. We assume single-core silicon depth is fixed.
